description: How to run each test case without a person deciding anything. A case file says what a case proves and which spec is its executable copy; this says what that spec needs to be handed - the project, the stage, the dataset rows, the environment. scripts/run-case.ps1 reads it. Nothing here is a default anyone has to remember: a case absent from this file cannot be launched by id, which is deliberate, because guessing a stage or a row set means writing the wrong thing to a live client.
